page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn9gc.4xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance powered by the x86_64 architecture. It features 16 dedicated physical cores from an AMD EPYC 9A75 processor running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The CPU configuration allocates one thread per core, providing dedicated compute resources without hyperthreading. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, which translates to 8.0 GB of RAM per core.

Acceleration is provided by a single NVIDIA Blackwell GPU containing 72 GB of VRAM. This server does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps. The instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The hardware profile represents a high-density compute and acceleration class, balancing dedicated AMD EPYC processing cores with Blackwell GPU architecture. The lack of local storage requires architectural planning for external storage latency, while the dedicated core allocation ensures predictable CPU execution. This configuration is engineered for workloads such as machine learning model inference, data science computations, and GPU-accelerated rendering tasks.
